title: Differentiate Between the append() Method and the extend() Method

blocks.content: Differentiate Between the append() Method and the extend() Method
Both methods are used with lists in Python. Both methods add elements at the end of a list.

items: append() - is used to add an element at the end of the list.
extend() - is used to add elements at the end of the list from another list.

blocks.content: Take a look at an example,

1# original list
2lst1 = [4, 3, 2, 5, 1, 6]
3print(lst1)    # [4, 3, 2, 5, 1, 6]
4
5# append an element
6lst1.append(9)
7print(lst1)    # [4, 3, 2, 5, 1, 6, 9]
8
9# extend another list
10lst2 = [0, 8, 7]
11lst1.extend(lst2)
12print(lst1)    # [4, 3, 2, 5, 1, 6, 9, 0, 8, 7]
